source: Chef Jean-Pierre, https://chefjeanpierre.com/recipes/garlic-aioli/, printed 2022-01-08. 1 page, three ingredients, one numbered step followed by an unnumbered storage sentence.
title: Garlic Aioli

steps.text: Put garlic cloves through a garlic press or mince very fine, then whisk into mayonnaise along with hot sauce.
If desired, adjust the seasoning. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate it will keep up to 6 days.
